panels.title: Запросы к PocketBase
panels.description: Из журнала запросов PocketBase (_logs в auxiliary.db).

targets.queryText:
SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', created) AS INTEGER) / max($__interval_ms / 1000, 60)) * max($__interval_ms / 1000, 60) AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(data, '$.status') < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "2xx/3xx",
  SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(data, '$.status') >= 400 AND json_extract(data, '$.status') < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "4xx",
  SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(data, '$.status') >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "5xx"
FROM _logs
WHERE json_extract(data, '$.type') = 'request' AND created >= strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND created < strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Самые медленные эндпоинты PocketBase
panels.description: Путь без query-строки. ID записей в пути не схлопываются.

targets.queryText:
SELECT json_extract(data, '$.method') AS method,
  substr(json_extract(data, '$.url'), 1, instr(json_extract(data, '$.url') || '?', '?') - 1) AS path,
  COUNT(*) AS requests,
  ROUND(AVG(json_extract(data, '$.execTime')), 1) AS avg_ms,
  ROUND(MAX(json_extract(data, '$.execTime')), 1) AS max_ms,
  SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(data, '$.status') >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors
FROM _logs
WHERE json_extract(data, '$.type') = 'request' AND created >= strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND created < strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY avg_ms DESC
LIMIT 20
targets.rawQueryText:

  ROUND(AVG(json_extract(data, '$.execTime')), 1) AS avg_ms,
  ROUND(MAX(json_extract(data, '$.execTime')), 1) AS max_ms,
  SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(data, '$.status') >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors
FROM _logs

GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY avg_ms DESC
LIMIT 20

targets.queryText:
SELECT created AS time,
  CASE level WHEN 8 THEN 'ERROR' WHEN 4 THEN 'WARN' ELSE level END AS level,
  json_extract(data, '$.status') AS status,
  json_extract(data, '$.method') AS method,
  json_extract(data, '$.url') AS url,
  COALESCE(json_extract(data, '$.error'), message) AS error
FROM _logs
WHERE (level >= 4 OR json_extract(data, '$.status') >= 400) AND created >= strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND created < strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
ORDER BY created DESC
LIMIT 200
